mythology: Madurai tradition remembers Meenakshi as Tadaatagai, the Pandya queen who married Shiva as Sundareswarar. The Chithirai festival celebrates their wedding.
pilgrimage_significance: Spiritual epicenter of Tamil culture and Shaiva-Shakta harmony; here Goddess Meenakshi receives the first puja before Lord Sundareswarar.
historical_notes: Two east-facing principal shrines in separate nested enclosures with Meenakshi south of Sundareswarar. The Golden Lily Tank lies east of Amman, and the Thousand Pillar Hall occupies the northeast. The plans and aerials guide the gates, halls, roof masses, enclosure lines and routes.
